name: strict-unit-contracts
goal: Make the existing strict units check pass while retaining unit UIDs and callable signatures. Match declared failures to source and explicitly document genuinely untrusted inputs.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: On origin/main be6e337e8c, bun run dev -- units check exits 1. 604 distinct contract findings: 594 retained from both supplied historical inventories plus 10 added on main. Exact stderr in attempt strict-evidence/red.log.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: This is repository manifest maintenance. Reused the existing strict registry check covering stored and rederived contracts. The checker identified the failing data before any repair; no checker or product test behavior changes are needed for this regression.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Harness recorded the strengthened existing contractFailureCounts example failing at 937ff1b860 on Stored unit manifests must pass strict contract validation. The unchanged gate will be rerun after the repair.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Aligned error names and causes with current implementations, documented unknown boundary reasons and resolved inferred parameter types. Canonically indexed current source and backfilled five previously unassigned new units. Existing UIDs, runtime targets, source ownership, parameter order, required flags, defaults and outputs were compared by unit and operation. Strict units check returned 0 for 2084 active units.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
